caption: The drawing depicts a single, clear glass candlestick placed centrally within the composition. The glass is rendered with subtle shades of gray, white, and blue to indicate transparency and reflective highlights, showing the thickness and contours of the material. The background is a plain, uncolored or lightly tan paper, with faint guidelines forming a square around the candlestick, suggesting the drawing was carefully measured and composed.
